title: Jabbo Smith
summary: He praises Jabbo Smith as a real jazz player he knew briefly.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Did you know, what is his name, Jabbo? Javeral (?)?
Jabbo Smith? Oh, boy. What a man.
What was your impression of Jabbo?
I didn't know him that long. No, I didn't. But, I knew him long enough. Let's see what was he playing. I think he was playing down out at Sheldon Johnson's (?) ... ( ??? )
Do you remember what year or around what time?
It was in the early days he was walking around like this.
Jabbo Javeral (?), did he, how did he compare with Louis Armstrong?
I don't know how to compare them. But, the only thing I know I just loved his playing. And he played jazz. And I mean real jazz.
